question: In computing, _______ is a network security system that monitors incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predefined security rules.
solution:
The correct answer is __**firewall**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A firewall is a **network security system** that **monitors incoming and outgoing network traffi**c based on **predefined security rules**.
 
• It can be **hardware or software** and based on a defined set of security rules it **accepts, rejects, or drops** that **specific traffic**.
 
• A **firewall creates** a **secure barrier** between the **internal network** and **outside untrusted networks** such as the Internet.
 
• Firewalls **guard traffic** at **ports** that are the **computer’s entry points** where **information is exchanged** with** external devices**.
 
• **Firewalls** are of **4 types** based on their **filtering methods**.
 
 
• **A packet-filtering firewall**
 
• **A stateful inspection firewall**
 
• **A proxy firewall **
 
• **A Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW)​**
 
 

**​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1ccea7d2d091d14c90aef479a9bfcd0f7eaf45f7183153d6ed9fe3b735f0f4d.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Router** receives and sends data on **computer networks**.

 
 
• They connect two or more **packet-switched networks** or **subnetworks**.
 
• Router **manages traffic** between **networks** by forwarding **data packets** to their** intended IP addresses**.
 
• The router allows** multiple devices** to use the same **Internet connection**.
 
 
 
• **Network Switch** connects **devices within a network** and** forwards data packets** to and from those devices.
 
 
• Network switch only **sends data to the single device** it is **intended** for, **not to networks of multiple devices**.
 
 
 
• **Gateway** is a node it is a physical place where the data stops for **either transporting or reading/using**.
 
 
• It is a **stopping point** for data on its way to or **from other networks**.
 
• **Gateways** let us send data and **communicate back and forth**.
